_comment: Turnkey policy set for the turbo-juparzo API user. NOT uploaded anywhere. Placeholders in <...> must be filled at setup:

<API_USER_ID> = the NON-ROOT Turnkey user that owns the P-256 API key on disk (still unknown). Organization id is set via env TURNKEY_ORG_ID (still unknown). Signer filled 2026-11-09: 9Ao3ggbuUaiWPzYKr4VdsNQ9LMzM6MPmraZRVv4gv1UW (profile turnkey in config/wallet.json);
WSOL ATA 2cvHExWS1E1EPgTrNnfxo3eAtFepfZ8cBZW2xamSoYPM and USDC ATA 3hQu4N3TECymZCPeZeq7X1vMkic8APDJvjnpUouAaFqZ derived offline with metis_offline.pda (Token program).
Evaluation (docs.turnkey.com/concepts/policies/overview): root quorum bypasses all policies; any matching DENY wins; else any matching ALLOW; else implicit DENY.

A policy whose condition hits an evaluation error is SKIPPED: an erroring ALLOW allows nothing, an erroring DENY denies nothing (docs.turnkey.com/concepts/policies/language#evaluation-errors-and-short-circuiting). The ALLOW policies below are therefore the real protection; the DENY policies are a belt only.
&& and || do not short-circuit and have equal precedence: every mixed expression is parenthesised.

Shapes checked offline against two real unsigned Jupiter builds from this repo (SOL->USDC, v0, 1 ALT): outer programs ComputeBudget, ATA, System, Token, Jupiter are all static keys; the System transfer payer->WSOL ATA and Jupiter accounts[0..2] (authority, WSOL ATA, USDC ATA) are static; mints and the AMM come from the ALT.

NOT enforceable by Turnkey: daily/cumulative spend (no such field), the swap's quoted/min output, V0 priority fee (priority_fee_lamports is V1-only), sell-side token amounts inside Jupiter CPIs. Those are local checks (metis-offline + sign gate + tools/turnkey_signer.py).

policies.policyName: turbo-juparzo: allow bounded Jupiter SOL->USDC swap
policies.notes: One System transfer <= 1000000 lamports into the signer's WSOL ATA; only ComputeBudget/System/Token/ATA/Jupiter programs; exactly one Jupiter route_v2 instruction whose authority/source/destination are the signer, its WSOL ATA and its USDC ATA; no SPL transfers.

policies.notes: Belt only (an erroring DENY is skipped). Destinations other than the signer's WSOL ATA and 3YxV, including lookup-table placeholders.
Belt only. Top-level SPL Transfer/TransferChecked/TransferCheckedWithFee are never needed by the swap.
The allow policies are written for LEGACY/V0 only.
